exact.<b>브레드보드</b><br>\n왼쪽에서 부품을 고른 뒤 구멍에서 구멍으:
Breadboard
Pick a part on the left, then drag from hole to hole or click two holes in turn to place it. Plug jumper wires into the instrument terminals on the left of the board (power CH1·CH2, function generator) to power the circuit.

Power supply Set the voltage and current limit for each channel, then turn the output on. If the load current goes over the limit, it switches to CC and the voltage drops.
Function generator Outputs sine, square, triangle, and sawtooth waves and DC through a 50 Ω output.
Oscilloscope Pick 'CH1/CH2 probe' from the tools and click a hole to clip it on. Ground is CH1 − (common ground). With a fast time base, the simulation runs slower than real time, and the speed ratio appears in the status bar.

Drag the lead end of a selected part to move it to another hole. Double-click a switch to flip it. Hover over a hole to highlight the connected holes and show its voltage.

The simulation uses simple educational models. Values may differ from real parts.

exact.DATA 핀 하나로 온도와 습도를 보냅니다. DHT 라이브러리로 읽습니다: Sends temperature and humidity over a single DATA pin. Read it with the DHT library.
exact.DIN, CS, CLK로 LED 64개를 제어합니다. LedControl: Controls 64 LEDs through DIN, CS, and CLK. Uses the LedControl library; call shutdown(0, false) first to turn it on.
Gives a tone of about 2.3kHz when set HIGH.
exact.I2C 방식 16×2 글자 LCD입니다. SDA는 A4, SCL은 A5에: A 16×2 character LCD using I2C. Connect SDA to A4 and SCL to A5. If no text appears, check init() and backlight().
exact.IN이 HIGH면 COM이 NO에, LOW면 NC에 연결됩니다. 다른 회: When IN is HIGH, COM connects to NO; when LOW, to NC. A switch that turns another circuit on and off.
exact.L9110S 드라이버가 달린 모터입니다. IA에 PWM, IB에 LOW면: A motor with an L9110S driver. PWM on IA and LOW on IB runs it forward; the reverse runs it backward. Do not connect a motor directly to a pin.
exact.LCD의 SDA는 A4, SCL은 A5에 연결해야 합니다: Connect the LCD's SDA to A4 and SCL to A5
exact.LCD의 SDA와 SCL이 바뀌었습니다. SDA는 A4, SCL은 A5입: The LCD's SDA and SCL are swapped. SDA goes to A4, SCL to A5
exact.LED 다리 하나가 연결되지 않았습니다: One LED leg is not connected
exact.LED 방향이 반대입니다. 긴 다리(+)를 출력 쪽에 연결하십시오: The LED is backward. Connect the long leg (+) to the output side
exact.LED에 저항이 없습니다. 220Ω 저항을 직렬로 연결하십시오: The LED has no resistor. Connect a 220Ω resistor in series
exact.RGB LED의 − 핀을 GND에 연결하십시오: Connect the RGB LED's − pin to GND
exact.TRIG에 10µs 펄스를 보내고 pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH)로: Send a 10µs pulse to TRIG and time it with pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH). Distance (cm) = time (µs) ÷ 58.
exact.VRx·VRy는 아날로그 핀(가운데 약 512), SW는 디지털 핀에 연: Connect VRx·VRy to analog pins (about 512 at center) and SW to a digital pin. Read SW with INPUT_PULLUP; it is LOW when pressed.
exact.Vout 전압이 온도에 비례합니다. LM35는 10mV/°C, TMP36: The Vout voltage is proportional to temperature. LM35 gives 10mV/°C; TMP36 gives 0.5V + 10mV/°C.
exact.a~g, dp를 디지털 핀에 연결합니다. COM은 캐소드형이면 GND,: Connect a–g and dp to digital pins. Connect COM to GND for common cathode, or to 5V for common anode.
exact.tone(핀, 주파수)로 소리를 냅니다. digitalWrite()로는: Use tone(pin, frequency) to make sound. digitalWrite() does not make sound.
exact.가변저항 양 끝을 5V와 GND에 연결하십시오: Connect both ends of the potentiometer to 5V and GND
exact.갈색 GND, 빨강 5V, 주황 신호선입니다. Servo 라이브러리로 0: Brown is GND, red is 5V, orange is signal. Set 0–180° with the Servo library.
DO is HIGH when tilted and LOW when upright (SW-520D).
exact.긴 다리(+)는 출력 핀, 짧은 다리(−)는 GND에 연결합니다. 220: Connect the long leg (+) to an output pin and the short leg (−) to GND. Add a 220Ω resistor in series.
exact.누르는 동안 두 핀이 연결됩니다. 입력 핀과 GND에 연결하고 INPUT: The two pins connect while pressed. Connect it to an input pin and GND and use INPUT_PULLUP; it reads LOW when pressed. You can press it on the canvas.
AO rises as light gets brighter. DO is HIGH when darker than the threshold.
exact.서보는 analogWrite()가 아니라 Servo 라이브러리로 제어합니: Control a servo with the Servo library, not analogWrite()
AO rises as sound gets louder. DO is HIGH when louder than the threshold.
exact.수동 부저는 HIGH만으로 소리가 나지 않습니다. tone()을 쓰십시오: A passive buzzer makes no sound from HIGH alone. Use tone()
When an object is in front, OUT is LOW and the green LED lights.
exact.애노드형 7세그먼트의 COM은 5V에 연결해야 합니다: On a common-anode 7-segment display, connect COM to 5V
exact.양 끝은 5V와 GND, 가운데는 아날로그 핀에 연결합니다. analog: Connect both ends to 5V and GND and the middle to an analog pin. Read 0–1023 with analogRead(). Turn it with the mouse wheel.
OUT is HIGH when motion is detected.
exact.저항 내장 RGB LED입니다. R·G·B를 PWM 핀(~)에 연결해 a: An RGB LED with built-in resistors. Connect R·G·B to PWM pins (~) and mix colors with analogWrite().
Limits current. Use 220Ω for an LED and 10kΩ for a pull-down.
exact.캐소드형 7세그먼트의 COM은 GND에 연결해야 합니다: On a common-cathode 7-segment display, connect COM to GND
Turning it on connects the two pins; turning it off disconnects them. Click it on the canvas to switch.
exact.+ 입력과 − 입력의 차이를 아주 크게 키웁니다. 저항으로 되먹임을 걸어: Greatly amplifies the difference between the + and − inputs. Feedback through resistors sets the gain you want.
exact.NPN과 반대로, 베이스에서 전류를 빼면 이미터에서 컬렉터로 전류가 흐릅: The opposite of NPN: drawing current out of the base lets current flow from emitter to collector.
A switch that connects the middle common terminal to either A or B.
exact.거꾸로 걸린 전압이 정해진 값을 넘으면 전류를 흘려, 전압을 일정하게 지: When the reverse voltage exceeds a set value, it conducts current to hold the voltage steady.
exact.게이트에 전압을 걸면 드레인–소스 사이가 열립니다. 게이트로는 전류가 거: Applying voltage to the gate opens the path between drain and source. Almost no current flows into the gate.
There is no circuit to export. Insert parts and connect the power leads.
exact.베이스에 작은 전류를 넣으면 컬렉터에서 이미터로 큰 전류가 흐릅니다. 스: A small current into the base lets a large current flow from collector to emitter. Used as a switch or amplifier.
Moves the board view to this part and selects it.
Insert parts on the board and connect the power leads to draw the schematic.
exact.부품을 누르면 무엇인지 보여 줍니다. + 레일을 위, 접지를 아래에 두었: Click a part to see what it is. The + rail is at the top and ground at the bottom.
exact.부품을 누르면 무엇인지 보여 줍니다. 직렬·병렬로 정리해 사각 루프로 그: Click a part to see what it is. Parts are arranged in series and parallel and drawn as a rectangular loop.
exact.빛을 받으면 저항이 작아지는 저항입니다. 밝기에 따라 켜지는 회로에 씁니: A resistor whose resistance drops in light. Used in circuits that react to brightness.
A device that makes AC signals such as sine and square waves.
exact.손잡이를 돌리면 가운데 다리(와이퍼)의 위치가 바뀌어 전압을 나눠 줍니다: Turning the knob moves the middle leg (wiper) to divide the voltage. Used to adjust volume or brightness.
exact.실험용 전원 공급기의 1번 채널입니다. 전압과 전류 제한을 정해 회로에: Channel 1 of the lab power supply. Set the voltage and current limit to power the circuit.
exact.실험용 전원 공급기의 2번 채널입니다. 1번과 따로 떨어져 있어 직렬로: Channel 2 of the lab power supply. It is isolated from channel 1, so the two can be stacked in series.
exact.전기를 잠깐 모아 두었다가 내보냅니다. 직류는 막고 교류는 잘 통과시킵니: Stores charge briefly and then releases it. Blocks DC and passes AC easily.
exact.전류가 한쪽으로 흐르면 빛을 냅니다. 너무 큰 전류는 막아야 하므로 저항: Lights up when current flows in one direction. Use it with a resistor to block too much current.
exact.전류가 흐르기 어렵게 만들어 전류의 크기를 정합니다. 전압 = 전류 ×: Opposes current flow to set how much current flows. Voltage = current × resistance (Ohm's law).
exact.전류를 한쪽(애노드 → 캐소드)으로만 흐르게 합니다. 교류를 직류로 바꿀: Lets current flow in only one direction (anode → cathode). Used to convert AC to DC.
exact.전선을 감은 코일입니다. 전류가 갑자기 바뀌는 것을 막고, 교류일수록 잘: A coil of wound wire. It resists sudden changes in current, and blocks AC more as the frequency rises.
exact.커패시터가 충전·방전하는 시간으로 일정한 박자의 펄스를 만듭니다. LED: Makes pulses at a steady beat using the time a capacitor takes to charge and discharge. Often used to blink LEDs.
A power source that produces a steady voltage through a chemical reaction. The longer line is +.

exact.Serial 출력을 보고 글자를 보냅니다. 배선 실수와 오류는 문제 탭에: View Serial output and send text. Wiring mistakes and errors appear in the Problems tab.
Connect parts to a virtual Arduino UNO and run your code.
exact.누르면 설명, 두 번 누르거나 끌어 놓으면 추가: Click for info; double-click or drag to add
exact.보낼 내용 입력 후 Enter: Type a message and press Enter
exact.부품을 누르면 설명이 나옵니다. 캔버스로 끌어 놓거나 두 번 누르면 추가: Click a part to see its description. Drag it onto the canvas or double-click to add it.
exact.부품을 캔버스로 끌어 놓습니다.\n핀 두 개를 차례로 누르면 점퍼선이 연:
Drag parts onto the canvas.
Click two pins in turn to connect a jumper wire.
Select a part to change its settings and sensor values here.
exact.선택한 부품의 설정과 센서 값을 바꿉니다. 실행 중에도 바꿀 수 있습니다: Changes the selected part's settings and sensor values. You can change them while running.
exact.실행(F5), 정지, 리셋, 속도를 고릅니다. 오른쪽에 가상 시간과 실행: Choose Run (F5), Stop, Reset, and speed. Virtual time and run speed are shown on the right.
Open a finished circuit and code, then press F5 to run.
exact.왼쪽 목록에서 부품을 끌어 놓거나 두 번 누릅니다. 핀을 누르고 다른 핀: Drag a part from the list on the left or double-click it. Click a pin, then another pin, to connect a wire. Write code and press F5 to run.
Pick parts on the left and wire them yourself.
exact.파일 › 예제에서 실습 10개를 고를 수 있습니다. 둘러보기는 보기 ›: Choose from 10 labs in File › Examples. Reopen the tour from View › Tour (F1).
exact.핀을 누르고 다른 핀을 누르면 점퍼선이 연결됩니다. 휠로 확대하고, 가운: Click a pin and then another pin to connect a jumper wire. Zoom with the wheel; drag with the middle button to pan.
exact.단락·부품 손상 경고창 띄우기: Warn about shorts and part damage
exact.실제 회로라면 부품이 뜨거워지거나 망가집니다. 출력을 끄고 연결을 확인하: In a real circuit, parts would heat up or break. Turn the outputs off and check the wiring.
exact.\n\n실제 회로라면 부품이 뜨거워지거나 망가집니다. 출력을 끄고 연결을: In a real circuit, parts would heat up or break. Turn the outputs off and check the wiring.
5 V → 330 Ω → LED. Turn on power supply CH1 and the LED lights up. The resistor limits the current to about 9 mA to protect the LED.
exact.9 V를 10 kΩ과 4.7 kΩ으로 나눕니다. 가운데 마디는 9 × 4: 10 kΩ and 4.7 kΩ split 9 V. The middle node is 9 × 4.7 ÷ 14.7 ≈ 2.88 V. Hover over a hole to check the voltage.
exact.가변저항의 와이퍼 전압으로 LED 전류를 바꿉니다. 가변저항을 고르고 오: The wiper voltage of the potentiometer sets the LED current. Select the potentiometer and move its position in the right panel.
exact.10 kΩ × 100 µF, 시정수 1초. 전원을 켜면 커패시터가 천천히: 10 kΩ × 100 µF gives a 1 s time constant. Turn on the power and the capacitor slowly charges. Double-click the SPDT switch to discharge it. The scope is set to 500 ms/div.
exact.광저항(LDR)과 10 kΩ이 베이스 전압을 정하고, NPN 트랜지스터가: The photoresistor (LDR) and 10 kΩ set the base voltage, and the NPN transistor switches the LED. Select the LDR and lower the light level to turn the LED on.
exact.470 Ω과 5.1 V 제너 다이오드로 일정한 전압을 만듭니다. 전원 C: 470 Ω and a 5.1 V Zener diode make a steady voltage. Change CH1 anywhere from 9 to 15 V and the output stays near 5.1 V.
exact.함수 발생기의 50 Hz 교류를 다이오드로 한쪽만 통과시키고, 100 µ: A diode passes only one half of the 50 Hz AC from the function generator, and a 100 µF capacitor smooths it. Scope CH1 is the input and CH2 the output. Remove the capacitor to see the difference.
exact.555 비안정 발진: 1 kΩ, 47 kΩ, 10 µF로 약 1.5 Hz: 555 astable: 1 kΩ, 47 kΩ and 10 µF give about 1.5 Hz. Scope CH1 is the capacitor voltage (swinging between 1/3 and 2/3 VCC); CH2 is the output.
exact.전압 분배 바이어스(47 kΩ·10 kΩ), 컬렉터 4.7 kΩ, 이미터: Voltage-divider bias (47 kΩ, 10 kΩ), 4.7 kΩ collector, 1 kΩ emitter. Feed a 1 kHz 0.2 Vpp signal through the coupling capacitor and the output is about 3 times larger and inverted.
exact.±12 V 전원(CH1과 CH2를 쌓음), 입력 10 kΩ, 되먹임 10: ±12 V supply (CH1 and CH2 stacked), 10 kΩ input, 100 kΩ feedback. The gain is −100k ÷ 10k = −10. A 1 kHz 1 Vpp input gives a 10 Vpp output with opposite phase.
exact.느리면 빠른 계산으로 바꾸기 (정밀도 낮춤): Switch to fast mode when slow (lower precision)
Shows the present voltage on every node (relative to CH1 −).
